exact_statement: For every r>=1 let n=2r+1, c=binom(2r,r)/4^r, g(a,y)=(1+a)/2+(1-a)Maj_n(y)/2, f=a*(product y_j)*g, and the actual one-bit parity lift F(a,y,z)=f(az,yz). All inputs are uniform independent signs. H(F)=H(f)=2+H(Maj_n)/2, I(f)=n+1/2-nc/2, I(F)=n+1-nc/2, and I_z(F)=1/2. The full upper-set discount d=U(f)-U(F) obeys d>=1/4+(nc^2/4)log2(1+1/c^2)>=1/4+(1/8)log2(r+2). Both actual padding children have full U(f), so Delta_z U(F)=-d and |Delta_z U(F)|/I_z(F)>=1/2+(1/4)log2(r+2) diverges. Exact all-r finite-sum U,G formulas are given in PROOF.md, with G(F)<=-2d. Nevertheless H(f)<=2I(f) and H(F)<2I(F). Thus added-padding-influence-only ABSOLUTE U payment fails; signed one-sided GU and FEI are not refuted.
